## 1. Group result (pre-audit, later revised)

| Measure | H2 FY26 | H2 FY25 | Movement |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Group sales | $9,102.4m | $8,860.2m | +2.7% |
| Group EBIT | **$398.1m** | $389.4m | +2.2% |
| Cost of doing business (CODB) | **22.1%** | 22.0% | +10 bps |
| Net debt | **$1,133.7m** | $1,188.5m | −$54.8m |
| Return on funds employed | 12.9% | 13.1% | −20 bps |

## 2. Supply chain transformation

The DC-7 Truganina automation pilot is running at 1,105 cartons per hour
against a 1,450 design target. A decision on phase 2 at Dandenong South is
outstanding. No go / no-go date has been set.

Programme spend to date is $39.8m.

## 3. Risks

1. Single-source conveyor dependency.
2. Peak-season freeze from November.
3. Wage cost trajectory, modelled at 3.5%.

## 4. Notes

This reformatting pass was abandoned before the numbers were refreshed against
the audited close. It should not be circulated.
